<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/dogfood`, `@objectstack/http-conformance`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/service-print`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **16** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/dogfood/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/qa/http-conformance/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.ts`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx`  _(via PrintServicePlugin (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx`  _(via PrintServicePlugin (symbol, a top-level class), handlePrintDoor (symbol, a field of class PrintService; a method of interface IPrintDoorService), handlePrintDoor (literal, a string literal in member), /api/v1/print/records (route, a path literal in a comment in IPrintDoorService; a path literal in a comment on a changed line))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **8** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/qa/dogfood/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/qa/http-conformance/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.ts`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **9** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **182** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e032675d9a394f7f0d50759712c3bb7c2443ab90` — the merge of head `5e8218146fd23a177e0bd351e1ae921e29c40ce0` into base `4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e032675d9a394f7f0d50759712c3bb7c2443ab90 && git checkout e032675d9a394f7f0d50759712c3bb7c2443ab90
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de 5e8218146fd23a177e0bd351e1ae921e29c40ce0 && git checkout -B drift-repro 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de && git merge --no-ff 5e8218146fd23a177e0bd351e1ae921e29c40ce0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4f19091997f67617cfdf48b5f7051e7bf86725de` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c6a48bff3c98094ad16af2932ef0542ab26b25e1`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/contracts/print-door-service.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/index.ts, packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json, packages/spec/export-origins/contracts.json + packages/services/service-print/src/print-door-member.ts, packages/services/service-print/src/print-service-plugin.ts, packages/services/service-print/src/print-service.ts, packages/services/service-print/package.json, packages/runtime/src/domains/print.ts, packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts, packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts, ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts, scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs, ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs, content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx, .changeset/36840-print-door-hosted.md, and the tests
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

PR #36845 (card #36840), reviewed as the ten commits `fe9b373660..c6a48bff3c` on top of `8644ce711d`: 37 files, +761 −29. Read with `git diff` / `git show` and the REST API; nothing was checked out, built or run. Inputs: the PR body, the card, claim comment 7121489649, the os-dev-report 7126049411. Code outside the diff was read but not reviewed: `own-door-bridge.ts`, `print-routes.ts`, `door-table-member.ts`, `action-dispatch.ts`, `action-execution.ts` (the api forward), `error-message.ts`, `authz-conformance.matrix.ts`, `print-door-impersonation.dogfood.test.ts`.

No should-fix finding.

- **N1:** The console line is chosen by code alone, and `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` is the platform's general 503, not only "this service is not composed". The print door answers it for a permission store that cannot be read (`print-routes.ts`, step ①) and for an engine probe that failed, and its own 503 sentence already says "right now". After this PR each of those reads 「此操作所需的服务在当前环境未启用，请联系管理员。」 for every `type: 'api'` action (`flowResponse.ts:352`, `:500`). For an outage that a retry would clear, "not enabled" is not accurate; the English line ("not available in this environment") is closer. A 503 whose producer wrote its sentence for the caller (`refusal: true`) is replaced too, unless it carries `userMessage`. The PR body states the choice; the seat should confirm the wording covers "not available now" as well as "not enabled".
- **N2:** The same rule reads a `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` or `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` as an absent service. An action whose `target` is misspelled now shows its author the service line where the route text used to name the path. The response body still carries it.
- **N3:** The card's own path is not pinned end to end. The card's request was `POST /actions/crm_quote/print_quote`, forwarded in-process to `/print/records`. The tests pin the two halves separately: the door through `createHonoApp` on a kernel with no `http.server`, and the console's reading of the envelope the actions door relays. No test drives an api action through the actions door to the bridged print door. Read against `forwardApiAction` and `apiActionForwardRefusal`, the forward injects a fresh request with its body unread and relays the target's `code` and status unchanged, so the halves do meet.
- **N4:** The impersonation refusal is pinned on the self-hosted mount only (`print-door-impersonation.dogfood.test.ts`). The bridged face runs the same handler, and the conformance file compares two answers (anonymous, signed in with no engine) byte for byte across the faces; an impersonation case there would pin the third.
- **N5:** `own-door-bridge.ts:7` still says `personal-views.ts` and `attachments.ts` are "its two callers"; `print.ts` is a third. The file is not in the diff. The comment in `check-route-envelope.mjs` was brought up to date.
- **N6:** The claim's amended file surface names `ui/packages/core/src/actions`. The diff changes `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts` instead, and also `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs`, `ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` and two `packages/qa` configs. The seat should amend the claim.
- **N7:** The PR body counts 71 check-runs at the head. The head now carries 75: 64 success, 11 skipped.
- **N8:** A security item is with the seat. It does not change the verdict.

### ① Derived judgments

**The spec member.** `IPrintDoorService` is one interface with one member, `handlePrintDoor?(request: Request): Promise<Response>`, the shape of `IAttachmentDoorsService.handleAttachmentDoor`. It is optional, it is exported from `packages/spec/src/contracts/index.ts`, and `api-surface/contracts.json` and `export-origins/contracts.json` each gain exactly its one row. The file holds no runtime statement. The type pins in `print-door-service.test.ts` turn red for a required member, a different parameter list, a different return type, or a barrel that exports a look-alike.

**One body, two faces.** `PrintServicePlugin.init()` builds the member with `createPrintDoorMember` over `registerPrintRoutes(http, printRoutesDeps(ctx, service))`, and the `http.server` branch at `kernel:ready` calls the same `registerPrintRoutes` with the same `printRoutesDeps`. The four dependencies (`print`, `getEngine`, `getAuth`, `resolveTenancyPosture`) are the four the mount had before, moved into one function, still read per request. So the caller resolution, the anonymous floor, the held sign-in refusal, the impersonation refusal, the closed body field set and the relay of the service's refusals are one copy.

| Claim | Source at head | Holds |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the bridge claims exactly `POST /print/records` | `print.ts:29-40`; `matchOwnDoorPath`; 8 misses in the `print` family of `own-door-bridge.test.ts` | yes |
| every other shape under `/print` stays `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` | `handleOwnDoorBridgeRequest`, first statement; the same 8 misses | yes |
| an empty slot or a missing member answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` naming the package | the bridge's two 501 arms; the family's three 501 cases; the conformance file's last case | yes |
| the slot is the request kernel's, read per request | `getRequestKernelService`; the family's per-request and request-kernel cases | yes |
| the body is forwarded unread | `atWirePath`; the family's first and environment-scoped cases | yes |
| no preamble-gate exemption | no entry added to the auth-gate allow-list or to the membership gate; the family's three gate cases | yes |
| the `http.server` mount is unchanged and no path is mounted twice | `print-service-plugin.ts`, the `kernel:ready` branch; the private table never listens | yes |
| the answers are the mount's own | `print-door-member.test.ts` (anonymous 401 on both faces); the conformance file's byte comparison | yes |

**The member's dependencies belong to the kernel that serves the request.** `printRoutesDeps` closes over the plugin's own `ctx`, so the caller is resolved against the auth service, the engine and the tenancy posture of the kernel whose `print` slot the bridge read. A tenant request cannot be judged or served by another kernel's services.

**The console line.** `apiActionFailureMessage` reads the line when the envelope's code is one of four and the envelope carries no `userMessage`. The actions door relays a refused forward with the target's own `code` and status (`apiActionForwardRefusal`), so the card's `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` body, the new 501 and the door's 503 each reach the rule. `flowResponse.test.ts` uses the card's body verbatim, asserts the zh-Hans and en lines and the absence of `/print/records`, the English fallback for an unknown locale, the `userMessage` precedence, and a `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` control that keeps its sentence.

**Locale keys.** `actions.serviceUnavailable` is present in all 11 packs under `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales` (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant). The dead-key script's note names the key and why it reads live.

**Tests would fail without the change.** Without the domain, the `print` family's forward and 501 cases get the dispatcher's 404. Without the member, `print-door-member.test.ts` has no function to call and the conformance file's first three cases get 501. Without the console rule, the four absent-service cases read the server's prose.

### ② Semver level

- `Metadata-protocol: none` holds: no key, value or metadata type an author can write changes. So `patch` is the level on every package named.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` holds: a new exported interface with one optional member, a new member on the `print` service, a new dispatcher route, a new locale key. Nothing is removed or tightened. Both lines start their lines in the PR body and in the changeset, with the same values.
- `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/service-print`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@object-ui/i18n`: patch, each with source in the diff.
- `@object-ui/console: patch` names the published package for a change made in `ui/packages/app-shell`, which is private. That is accurate for what ships.
- `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` is not named and is not changed. It becomes a runtime dependency of service-print, as it is of service-storage; it does not depend back on either.
- One wire answer changes for an existing deployment: on a kernel that does not compose service-print, `POST /api/v1/print/records` through the dispatcher answered `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` and now answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`. The changeset says so.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The claim's file surface and the diff differ (N6).
- The cloud half (mounting the service per environment, and a browser engine) is held for the maintainer's decision and is not in this diff. Until it lands, a hosted user reads the localized line and gets no PDF; the card's expectation 1 stays open, and the PR's `Fixes #36840` would close the card on merge. The seat should decide whether the card stays open for the cloud half.
- Behaviour for an existing user: a self-hosted kernel with an `http.server` keeps its mount; the print answers are unchanged. Every `type: 'api'` action's failure text changes for the four codes (N1, N2).
- SQL push-down: no record query in the diff.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no separate login to name. The PR is a draft with auto-merge not armed.
- The PR touches no `.claude/**` path and declares no `Rule-change:` line.
- Check-runs at the head: 64 success, 11 skipped, none failed, none pending.

### ④ Design judgment

`packages/spec/src/contracts/print-door-service.ts` (hits): the member is the smallest shape that lets a dispatcher reach the door without a transport type, and it is the shape the two earlier members of this class already use, so a reader who knows one knows all three. The docblock states who the one caller is, that the caller is resolved from the request, and that absence is a typed 501.

`packages/services/service-print` and `packages/runtime/src/domains/print.ts`: the design adds no second copy of the door. The member is built over the registration the mount runs and the dependencies the mount reads, and the bridge is a data row handed to the shared bridge, so the print door inherits the bridge's claim, forwarding and fault handling rather than restating them. The ledger row and the envelope guard's declaration follow the two earlier rows.

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`: reading the line from the resident catalogue, the way the permission line is read, is the right mechanism, and keeping `userMessage` first keeps the producer's escape. The rule is broader than the card needs: it keys on four codes for every api action, and one of them is the general 503 (N1). The card's case is covered either way.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-p90smw`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fbe9c751e17c08cef1df698ca727f5c35a800538`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the delta `c6a48bff3c..fbe9c751e1` on top of the review at comment 7126194758: ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/__tests__/flowResponse.test.ts, .changeset/36840-print-door-hosted.md, content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx, packages/runtime/src/domains/own-door-bridge.ts (comment only), ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs (comment only)
Security-touching: yes
Rule-change-verified: none

PR #36845 (card #36840), second round. The head equals the PR's `head.sha`. The delta is one commit, `fbe9c751e1`, whose parent is the head reviewed before: 6 files, +62 −42. Read with `git diff` / `git show` and the REST API; nothing was checked out, built or run. Inputs: the previous record, the PR body at this head, the card's comments. Code outside the delta was read but not reviewed: `ui/packages/types/src/error-code.ts`, `ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts`, and the server-side producers of `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` under `packages/`.

No should-fix finding.

- **N1: closed.** `apiActionFailureMessage` now reads the localized line for one code, `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (`flowResponse.ts:353`, `:501`). A `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` falls through to `refusalEnvelopeMessage` and keeps the producer's sentence. The test pins it in zh-CN and en, and asserts the result is neither locale's service line.
- **N2: closed.** `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` and `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` fall through too. The test uses a misspelled target (`/prnt/records`) for both codes and asserts the shown text is the envelope's message and contains the path.
- **N3: open, as the author states.** No test drives an api action through the actions door to the bridged print door. The two halves stay pinned separately. The PR body says so.
- **N4: open.** The impersonation refusal is still pinned on the self-hosted mount only. The delta does not touch it.
- **N5: closed.** `own-door-bridge.ts:7` names `personal-views.ts`, `attachments.ts` and `print.ts` as its callers. The change is one comment line.
- **N6: open, with the seat.** The card carries no amendment to claim comment 7121489649. The file surface it names still differs from the diff.
- **N7: open.** The body still gives the earlier head's count as 71 check-runs (62 success, 9 skipped) and says CI at this head is running. This head carries 75 check-runs: 64 success, 11 skipped, none failed, none pending.
- **N8: unchanged.** The security item is with the seat. The delta does not touch it and it does not change the verdict.
- **N9 (new):** The rule keys on the code alone, not on the status and not on who answered. `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` is a standard-catalogue code with many producers besides the own-door bridge: a driver that cannot run a query shape (a filtered aggregation, a date bucket in a zone, an upsert on one SQL dialect, a transaction on a remote transport), a row lock the driver cannot take, an auth route whose plugin is not enabled, a walled deployment with no site binding. An api action whose `target` reaches any of them, with no `userMessage`, now shows 「此操作所需的服务在当前环境未启用，请联系管理员。」 and not the producer's sentence. For each of these the line is close to true: the gap belongs to the deployment or its backend, a retry does not clear it, and the person who clicked can only ask an administrator. It is not accurate for a backend capability gap, where no service is missing, and the constant's comment (`flowResponse.ts:342-352`) describes the bridge as the code's only source. The envelope still carries the producer's message. The seat should confirm the line is wanted for every `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, or ask for the rule to be narrowed to the bridge's answer.
- **N10 (new):** The changeset's title line still says the line replaces "the route text". After this delta the line replaces the 501's package sentence, and a route miss keeps its text. The bullet below the title says it correctly.

### ① Derived judgments

**The rule at this head.** One statement decides it: no `userMessage` on the envelope, and `errorCodeIs(envelope, 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED')`. `errorCodeIs` compares the string `code` without regard to case and reads nothing else. `errorCodeIsAnyOf` is no longer imported in the file, and it is still used elsewhere in the tree, so no export goes dead.

| Claim | Source at head | Holds |
|:--|:--|:--|
| only `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` reads the service line | `flowResponse.ts:353`, `:501`; the 501 test in zh-CN and en | yes, by code; see N9 |
| a `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` keeps the producer's sentence | fall-through to `refusalEnvelopeMessage`; the 503 test in two locales | yes |
| `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` and `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` keep the path | the route-miss test, both codes | yes |
| a `userMessage` still wins | the `userMessage` test, now on the 501 body | yes |
| an unknown locale falls back to English | the fallback test | yes |
| the changeset, `print-pages.mdx` and the dead-key note agree with the code | each now says the 501 reads the line and the 503 and the route miss keep their sentence | yes; N10 for the title |
| `own-door-bridge.ts:7` names three callers | the one-line comment change | yes |
| the body says `Refs #36840` | body line 4; no `Fixes` or `Closes` keyword for the card | yes |
| the body's check counts are current | the body's last Verification line | no (N7) |

**A 501 from a route that is not the print door.** It shows the service line, in the user's language, unless the producer set `userMessage`. That is right for an own-door bridge with an empty slot (personal views, attachments, print). For the other producers it is N9.

**The card's own case still reads the line.** With the bridge in, a hosted kernel that does not compose the print service answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, and the actions door relays the target's code and status unchanged, so 「打印报价」 shows the localized line. Dropping the route-miss codes costs the card nothing at this head. A host that runs a runtime older than this PR with a console newer than it would show the route text again; the two ship together in one changeset.

**Tests would fail without the change.** With the previous four-code rule, the 503 test and the route-miss test turn red. With no rule, the 501 test turns red.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged from the previous record. `packages/spec` is not in the delta. No locale pack is in the delta: `actions.serviceUnavailable` is present in all 11 packs, with the same text as before.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` each start their line in the PR body (lines 6 and 7) and in the changeset, with the same values.
- The changeset names the same five packages at `patch`. The delta narrows a console behaviour this PR itself introduced and that no release carries, so the level does not move.
- The one wire change for an existing deployment is the same: a kernel without the print service answers `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED` on `POST /api/v1/print/records` where it answered `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `Fixes` became `Refs`, so merging leaves card #36840 open for the cloud half. The card is open now.
- Behaviour for an existing user: an api action's failure text changes for one code where the previous head changed it for four. A 503 and a route miss read as they do on `main`.
- The claim's file surface and the diff still differ (N6).
- The PR is a draft; mergeable state is clean. Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`.
- The delta touches no `.claude/**` path and declares no `Rule-change:` line.
- Check-runs at the head: 75, of which 64 success and 11 skipped. None failed, none pending.

### ④ Design judgment

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowResponse.ts`: the narrowing is the right direction. A code that means "not now" and a code that means "no such path" each had a reader the general line served badly, and both now keep the sentence written for them. One constant and one `errorCodeIs` call is the smallest form of the rule. What remains broad is that the code is shared with capability refusals that are not about a missing service (N9); the line's wording is tolerable for those, and the comment should say the rule covers them.

The tests name each case by what its reader needs (the package name hidden, the outage sentence kept, the path kept), so a later widening of the rule fails with a message that says which reader it harms.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-p90smw`
Reviewed-by: `session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读
托管云上点「打印报价」原来弹英文报错「Route Not Found」。现在平台能把打印请求送到打印服务；环境里没装打印服务时，提示改成中文「此操作所需的服务在当前环境未启用，请联系管理员」。托管云真正能出 PDF 还要在云端装浏览器，这一步等你在决定卡上选方案，本 PR 不动云端。
要你做的：无（普通改动，席位自动合并）。
